name: Niamh Devine (Mythological Goddess)
reason: Strict health rule: her own site (niamhdevine.com) sells her work on conditions, with the home and about pages framing it as taking people from illness to health and featuring her account of healing paralysis, a Language of the Body course for symptoms and pain, chakra transmissions sold 'for Physical Health' (organs, fertility, immune system), and energy and TRE sessions offered for illness, anxiety and chronic tension.
